notes.title: THANK YOU!
notes.content:
Hi all, Tom here!

I just wanted to post a quick update to say a big [b]THANK YOU[/b] to everyone for trying Upfall! It's been out for less than a week and we're already sitting at a Positive rating on Steam. That's [b]AWESOME![/b] This game was a bit of a shot in the dark (pun intended) as it's not a puzzle game and it's definitely a little freaky... so it's been so lovely to see people enjoying it and even completing some of it's more difficult challenges!

I also pushed a hotfix recently which fixes a small visual bug and gives a bit of a hint about how to unlock one of the trickier achievements. If you see a strange looking symbol in a bubble, make sure you pop it and check the main menu... you might find some breadcrumbs.

Finally, if you've enjoyed playing, do please drop a review for Upfall. It really does help with visibility (especially closer to launch) as it means we're more likely to show up in people's discovery queues. And who doesn't want, as one review says: "a slightly creepy echoing voice to tell them to keep going"? In a sense, isn't that what we all need right now? Especially as you can take it with you on the go if you have Steam Deck!

See you all in the reverb dimension...

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3570280/Upfall/

- Amicable Animal
